name: M. Faridh Maulana
intro: A Systems Administrator dedicated to architecting resilient infrastructure and managing Kubernetes clusters. I specialize in Penetration Testing, uncovering vulnerabilities in Web Applications and APIs to ensure enterprise-grade security. As a Full Stack Developer, I engineer high-performance, secure-by-design solutions utilizing Golang Fiber and TypeScript (Express.js & Bun). I don't just build systems—I harden them for the real world.
